abstract:
This is a Phase I/II, single-arm, open-label, exploratory study aimed at evaluating the safety, tolerability, and preliminary efficacy of stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) combined with gemcitabine and iparomlimab-toripalimab in patients with borderline resectable pancreatic cancer. The study is divided into two phases: The Phase Ib dose-escalation phase will use a "3+3" design to explore the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) of SBRT (6 Gy×5 F, 7 Gy×5 F, 8 Gy×5 F) combined with gemcitabine and iparomlimab-toripalimab. The Phase II phase will further evaluate the efficacy and safety of this combination regimen based on the SBRT dose determined in Phase Ib. The primary efficacy endpoint is the R0 resection rate.

This is a single-center, Phase I/II, single-arm, open-label, exploratory clinical study initiated by Tianjin Medical University Cancer Institute \& Hospital.

Phase Ib (Dose-Escalation Phase): A classic "3+3" design will be used to explore the dose-limiting toxicity (DLT) and maximum tolerated dose (MTD) of SBRT. Three pre-specified SBRT dose levels are planned: 6 Gy×5 F, 7 Gy×5 F, and 8 Gy×5 F. All subjects will concurrently receive standard-dose gemcitabine chemotherapy and iparomlimab-toripalimab immunotherapy. The DLT observation period is 6 months from the start of treatment, focusing on Grade 3 or higher SBRT-related toxicities in organs at risk. The MTD is defined as the highest dose level at which ≤33% (i.e., no more than 1 out of 6) of subjects experience a DLT during the observation period.

Phase II (Expansion Phase): Based on the SBRT MTD determined in Phase Ib, preoperative neoadjuvant therapy will be administered in combination with gemcitabine and iparomlimab-toripalimab. The treatment cycle consists of 3 cycles, expected to last 12 weeks. Tumor assessment will be performed after 2 cycles of treatment. If there is no disease progression and adverse reactions are tolerable, treatment will continue. Surgical resection will be performed 3-4 weeks after the last dose of chemotherapy and immunotherapy. Postoperatively, if the investigator determines the patient may benefit, adjuvant therapy will be administered, consisting of 4 cycles of gemcitabine chemotherapy and maintenance immunotherapy with iparomlimab-toripalimab for up to 1 year. The primary endpoint is the R0 resection rate.

summary_ko: 이 연구는 경계성 절제 가능한 췌장암 환자를 대상으로 정위체부방사선치료(SBRT)와 gemcitabine(젬시타빈) 및 iparomlimab-toripalimab 면역항암제를 병용하는 탐색적 1상/2상 임상시험입니다. 1b상에서는 3+3 설계 방식을 통해 SBRT의 최대 용량과 용량 제한 독성을 평가합니다. 2상에서는 결정된 SBRT 용량을 바탕으로 수술 전 선행치료를 시행하여 R0 절제율 등을 평가합니다. 총 목표 환자 수는 30명이며 톈진의대 암병원에서 진행됩니다.
title: A Phase I/II Single-Arm, Open-Label, Exploratory Study Evaluating the Safety and Efficacy of Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy (SBRT) Combined With Gemcitabine and Iparomlimab-Toripalimab in Borderline Resectable Pancreatic Cancer
title_ko: 경계성 절제 가능한 췌장암에서 정위체부방사선치료(SBRT)와 gemcitabine 및 iparomlimab-toripalimab 병합요법의 안전성과 유효성을 평가하는 1상/2상 임상시험

trial.eligibility_ko:
선정 기준:
- 나이 18세 이상 75세 이하의 남녀
- 조직학적 또는 세포학적으로 확진된 췌장관선암
- NCCN 가이드라인에 따라 방사선학적으로 평가된 경계성 절제 가능 췌장암
- RECIST v1.1 기준에 따른 측정 가능 병변이 최소 1개 이상
- ECOG 수행능력 점수 0 또는 1
- 기대 여명 6개월 이상

제외 기준:
- 알려진 원격 전이 있음
- 이전 췌장암 항암 치료 또는 방사선 치료 병력 있음
- 지난 2년 이내 전신 치료가 필요한 활동성 자가면역질환 있음
- 지난 5년 이내 다른 악성 종양 병력 있음
trial.eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Age ≥18 years and ≤75 years, both genders.
2. Histologically or cytologically confirmed pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
3. Radiographically assessed as borderline resectable pancreatic cancer according to NCCN guidelines.
4. At least one measurable lesion per RECIST v1.1 criteria.
5. Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status score of 0 or 1.
6. Adequate organ and bone marrow function.
7. Expected survival ≥ 6 months.
8. Voluntarily signed informed consent form.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Known distant metastases.
2. Prior systemic anti-tumor therapy or radiotherapy for pancreatic cancer.
3. Active autoimmune disease requiring systemic treatment within the past 2 years.
4. History of other malignancies within the past 5 years, except for cured carcinoma in situ of the cervix, non-melanoma skin cancer, or superficial bladder tumor.
5. Uncontrolled comorbid conditions, including but not limited to active infections, symptomatic congestive heart failure, unstable angina pectoris, or cardiac arrhythmia.
6. Pregnant or lactating women.
7. Any condition that, in the investigator's opinion, would make the subject unsuitable for participation in the study.
